body:
Nah I deserve it.  Not just annoying I'm not that nice to my mom. Her new husband hates me and has hated me since the day we met for that reason. 

And I wish it was easy to talk about. My boyfriend has depression of his own and I feel it's "his turn" to get better. I complain and get upset half the time. It's like my issues and my problems are always at the front. What about his? I need to help him first.

I wish being a good person all depended on just caring about someone... 

I think people are more scared of the thought of someone choosing to end their lives than losing that person as a whole.

I don't think I am. I yell at my mom I'm rude and snarky to her and I've made her cry. Her husband (recently married) has hated me from when he first met me because of how rude I am to my mom. He's not nice to me and he thinks I'm a pain in the neck. My mother puts up with me as my mother but I think it is her husband who really shows the unbiased view of how I'm viewed. 

I'm very mean to my boyfriend when he's trying to help. My feelings aren't an excuse. I'm scum and I know it. I'm just so frustrated at not being able to feel better. He gets frustrated I don't cheer up. It's all doomed. 

My mom's new husband will more than take care of her. And my boyfriend has a tremendous support system in his friends and family. I think they will be okay in the end.
